name: German Festival
description: Experience a taste of Germany in Porto with this family-friendly festival offering German food, music, and cultural activities.
longDescription:
The German Festival is an annual cultural event organized by the Goethe-Institut Portugal, dedicated to showcasing aspects of German culture in Porto. This free, family-friendly festival aims to foster cultural exchange and provide an accessible introduction to German traditions for the local community and visitors. It features a variety of activities centered around German food, music, and cultural engagement.

Visitors can expect an afternoon event with a relaxed atmosphere, suitable for all ages. The festival takes place at the Goethe-Institut Portugal, a cultural institution known for promoting German language and culture. The event offers opportunities to sample traditional German cuisine, listen to German music, and participate in various cultural activities designed to be engaging for families.

Admission to the German Festival is free, and walk-ins are welcome. The Goethe-Institut Portugal is located within walking distance of the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), approximately a 5-minute walk. The venue is generally accessible.
